## Read S (pre-registered, on A4)
- (a) correlation ≥ 0.3 in the half-error set: **False**; (b) ≥ 40% of energy in band 1: **False**.
- **Read S: FAIL.** As pre-registered, §4 (error diffusion, blue-noise masks) was **not run** in that allocation. **Correction (2026-10-28):** a white baseline error spectrum is not a valid impossibility gate for noise shaping. Shaping creates spatial structure rather than exploiting existing structure; what matters is downstream sensitivity by spatial frequency, which this diagnostic did not measure. Spatial shaping is untested, not ruled out.

## Reading
- The activations themselves are spatially correlated (x̃ adjacent correlation 0.27–0.70), but their A4 rounding error is essentially white: neighbouring tokens fall in the same grid cell only ≈ 27–48% of the time in the error-carrying types, and each token has its own dynamic scale, so the rounding residuals decorrelate. The exception, attn2.to_out (same-cell 0.81, correlation 0.25, band-1 0.48), carries a negligible share of the error.
- At A8 the error is white to three digits, as expected for fine grids.
- One cross-attention site type, attn2.to_q, carries ≈ 72% of the output-space activation error at both precisions. This is a side observation, not acted on (nothing new is authorized).
